# Sheetwrite

> Sheetwrite is a framework-agnostic, high-performance spreadsheet grid: a canvas grid backed by a Rust/WASM columnar engine, with an imperative core and React, Vue, and Svelte adapters.

Sheetwrite packages are released together at version 0.4.0. This index is generated from the repository documentation and the compiler-verified public API manifest.

## Full text

- [llms-full.txt](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every authored guide plus every public API declaration in one plain-text file. Fetch this when you need to answer a question or write code.

## Agent workflow

1. Choose one base package for your framework: `@sheetwrite/core` for vanilla, or `@sheetwrite/react`, `@sheetwrite/vue`, or `@sheetwrite/svelte`. Adapters bring core and the WebAssembly engine transitively and expose a package-local `styles.css`. Add optional feature packages, such as `@sheetwrite/xlsx`, only when the relevant guide requires them.
2. Initialize the runtime before mounting a grid. The imperative core awaits `initSheetwrite()` once per document; framework components initialize WebAssembly automatically after client mount, so server-rendered hosts need a client-only boundary.
3. The host owns the document. Sheetwrite never mutates host rows, so read Runtime ownership and Adapter lifecycle before choosing `defaultRows` seeding or explicit `workbook` plus `data`/`datasource` ownership.
4. Readiness is generation-scoped: adapters publish `{ grid, generation, reason }` with reason `initial`, `input-reset`, or `renderer-reset`, and replacing reset-bound inputs replaces the grid. Destroy the grid when its host element's lifetime ends.
5. Verify every symbol, option, event, and error code against the public API declarations in `llms-full.txt` or the generated API pages before using it. Anything absent from those declarations is not public API.
6. Recover through typed errors with stable codes (Error handling), and read Compatibility and limits before claiming Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice, or OpenFormula parity.

## Start

- [Installation](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/start/installation/): Install Sheetwrite for Vanilla, React, Vue, or Svelte and initialize its WebAssembly runtime.
- [Your first grid](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/start/first-grid/): Initialize Sheetwrite, create a workbook, and observe committed changes.

## Ownership and lifecycle

- [Runtime ownership](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/concepts/runtime-ownership/): Understand Sheetwrite runtime, renderer, store, virtualization, and document ownership boundaries.
- [Adapter lifecycle](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/lifecycle/): Initialization, readiness, resets, and transaction ownership across every Sheetwrite framework adapter.

## Framework adapters

- [Vanilla JavaScript](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/vanilla/): Own Sheetwrite initialization and Grid lifetime without a framework adapter.
- [React](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/react/): Integrate Sheetwrite with React ownership, readiness, and controlled resets.
- [Vue](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/vue/): Integrate Sheetwrite with Vue events, exposed Grid state, and resets.
- [Svelte](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/frameworks/svelte/): Integrate Sheetwrite with Svelte bindings, callbacks, and reset ownership.

- [Persistence and recovery](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/guides/persistence/): Persist versioned snapshots and durable pending mutations without confusing session state with document state.
- [Collaboration and offline work](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/guides/collaboration/): Sequence, persist, acknowledge, retry, and conservatively rebase Sheetwrite document operations.
- [Worker rendering](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/guides/worker-rendering/): Configure OffscreenCanvas worker painting and understand capability-based main-thread fallback.
- [XLSX and export](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/guides/xlsx-export/): Register the optional XLSX backend and choose table or workbook interchange deliberately.
- [Accessibility](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/guides/accessibility/): Understand the ARIA grid mirror, keyboard behavior, focus, and visible-window accessibility limits.
- [Keep app rows in your store](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/guides/host-owned-rows/): Use the row bridge when your app owns the row objects and Sheetwrite owns editing, history, sorting, and filtering. The bridge is optional. Without `getRowId`, `defaultRows` keeps its existing one-ti…

## More guides

- [Calculation engine](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/concepts/calculation-engine/): How Sheetwrite calculates formulas: two engine builds, incremental recalculation, spills, paged data, errors, and limits.
- [Analysis formulas](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/guides/analysis-formulas/): Summarize, forecast, and clean data with the full formula engine. Worked examples for every function family in @sheetwrite/formulas.

## Public API

- [API reference](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/api/): Generated reference for every classified Sheetwrite package entry point.
- [`@sheetwrite/core`](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/api/core/): 317 exports across 8 entry points (primary entry point: supported).
- [`@sheetwrite/formulas`](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/api/formulas/): 14 exports across 2 entry points (primary entry point: internal).
- [`@sheetwrite/react`](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/api/react/): 19 exports across 2 entry points (primary entry point: supported).
- [`@sheetwrite/svelte`](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/api/svelte/): 19 exports across 2 entry points (primary entry point: supported).
- [`@sheetwrite/vue`](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/api/vue/): 22 exports across 2 entry points (primary entry point: supported).
- [`@sheetwrite/wasm`](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/api/wasm/): 13 exports across 2 entry points (primary entry point: internal).
- [`@sheetwrite/xlsx`](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/docs/api/xlsx/): 7 exports across 2 entry points (primary entry point: supported).
- [Public API declarations](https://sheetwrite.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every export signature grouped by package and entry point. Do not invent symbols absent from it.
